concepts.def: s(t) position along an axis vs time.
v = ds/dt, instantaneous rate of position.
Link dy/dt to dx/dt via dy/dx.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Balloon: V = (4/3)πr^3, dV/dt = 12. Find dr/dt at r = 2.

dV/dt = 4πr^2 dr/dt, so 12 = 16π dr/dt, dr/dt = 3/(4π).
